name: xenophyophore
description: Xenophyophore: a giant single-celled foram, a lumpy, fragile, honeycombed grey-brown (#8a8274) mud-grain 'sponge' with lighter lobes, fold ridges, a fine reticulate net of thin ridges (#6e675b, ~20-unit cells), stuck sand grains, small pinhole pores and six irregular open dark pores (homes for tenants; largest off-centre bottom-right, no two alike, no face). Flat bottom resting on mud. Anchor bottom-centre (0,0), ~265x200 (x -132..132, y -196..0).
